rows.contract: Common submission/completion contract and virtual destruction
rows.native_mapping: Use one native owner with CPU tracker retained by Metal callbacks
rows.expected_result: No fences, secondary worker or Vulkan objects appear in dependencies

rows.contract: Logical next tick, known GPU tick, and IsFree
rows.native_mapping: Expose last issued/retired/successful ticks and nonwrapping unique Issue
rows.expected_result: Out-of-order callbacks cannot retire or signal past a gap
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: Refresh or wait for GPU completion then submit
rows.native_mapping: Native commit feedback drives retirement and signals proven completion; scheduler owns commit
rows.expected_result: CPU wait returns true on retirement and reports fault or close without blocking
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: Timeline implementation owns native semaphore; CPU waits on counter
rows.native_mapping: Own MTLSharedEvent in each native timeline, queue waits only when a producer succeeded
rows.expected_result: Two real queues preserve a dependent buffer read
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: Fence implementation tracks reusable fences and wait thread; no explicit refresh
rows.native_mapping: Actual commit feedback replaces the second subsystem and waits remain predicate-based
rows.expected_result: Close wakes waiters, accepted callbacks can still retire resources, timeouts are finite
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: A native pool must reject a completion timeline owned by another device.
rows.native_mapping: Expose the retained MTLDevice from the existing immutable semaphore state.
rows.expected_result: ARC compiler checks device accessor and scheduler may compare exact identity.
rows.actual_result: Native identity accessor compiled. Live identity comparison awaits GPU.
